name: Duelist Kingdom rules
author: DecompRecomp
description: Rules from the anime's Duelist Kingdom: one card drawn a turn after the opening five, a hand of up to forty, turn phases with a second Main Phase, the moth's evolution, equips that stay on the field, and no card lost to a fusion that does not work. Needs Extra hand plays.

cards.description: {f8 0A 05}<Poison dust>{f8 0A 00} At the start of each of its owner's turns, the opponent's monsters lose 300 ATK, and keep the loss.

cards.name: Multiply
cards.description: Equip Kuriboh only. It multiplies into a wall of hundreds: it stays in defense, and an attack on it destroys only one of the many.

cards.name: Polymerization
cards.description: Fuses monsters. With Living Arrow and a Zombie from your hand, it fuses the Zombie into a living monster of your opponent's, which rots from within.

cards.name: Living Arrow
cards.description: With Polymerization and a Zombie from your hand: shoots the Zombie into a living monster, which loses the Zombie's ATK every turn of yours.

cards.name: Mirror Force
cards.description: Springs on an attack: it turns back on every enemy monster in attack position. All are destroyed; the foe loses the attacker's ATK over each.

cards.name: Change of Heart
cards.description: Take control of one monster of your opponent's until the end of this turn. It may attack.

cards.name: Monster Reborn
cards.description: Bring back one monster from either player's graveyard to your side of the field.

cards.name: Magical Hats
cards.description: When your monster is attacked: the attack stops and it hides face down among up to three hats. An empty hat dies with no damage.

cards.name: Magical Hat
cards.description: A hat of Magical Hats: empty. It does nothing, and leaves when the monster hidden among the hats does.

settings.label: Playing a card is optional
settings.description: START in the first hand of a turn plays no card and goes on to the field, as in the anime. Without it a full field with nothing that fuses would leave no legal play.

settings.label: Turn phases
settings.description: START opens a menu of the next phases: from the hand (Main Phase 1) the Battle Phase or the End Phase; from the field the Main Phase 2, to play from the hand again after attacking, or the End Phase. The CPU plays as before.

settings.label: Draw one card a turn
settings.description: Each side opens with five cards, then draws one a turn (none on the first turn of the side that goes first). The hand holds up to forty. Off refills the hand to five each turn, as on the disc.

settings.label: Keep cards a fusion cannot use
settings.description: Cards put onto a monster must fuse with it or equip it, and marked cards must all fuse or equip in that order, so no card is thrown away. The player's confirm is refused; the CPU plays elsewhere, or no card.

settings.label: The moth's evolution (anime)
settings.description: As in Weevil's duels: Cocoon of Evolution put onto Petit Moth or Larvae Moth, or the two fused from the hand, makes the cocoon, in defense. At its owner's 5th turn after, it opens: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth. Destroyed before, it dies with the larva, unless it has had 4 of those turns: then Great Moth comes out in its place, in attack. A Cocoon played alone stays a Cocoon.

settings.label: Equips stay on the field
settings.description: As in the anime and the card game: an equip goes to the magic and trap zone behind its monster (or the nearest free one) and stays there. Destroyed, it takes its bonus with it; the monster leaving the field destroys its equips. With no free zone, the equip cannot be played. An equip on the field is not used again.

settings.label: The swamp brothers (anime)
settings.description: As in Joey's duel with Rex Raptor: with Swamp Battleguard and Lava Battleguard on the same side, a monster attacking one of them meets both. The attacked one fights in attack position with its brother's ATK added (1800 + 1550 = 3350), even from defense; the weaker side loses its monster and the difference.

settings.label: Kuriboh and Multiply (anime)
settings.description: As in Yugi's duel with Kaiba at the castle: Multiply, an equip of Kuriboh's, raises a wall of Kuribohs that takes no monster zone (drawn with 3D Monsters). While it is on the field the Kuriboh stays in defense and cannot leave it; an attack on it goes to the wall, where a clone dies and another takes its place, and costs no life points. The other monsters are attacked as ever, as Yugi's Celtic Guardian was. Destroying Multiply breaks the wall.

settings.label: Living Arrow (anime)
settings.description: As in Yugi's duel with Kaiba at the castle: Polymerization, Living Arrow and a Zombie (Mammoth Graveyard too, as in the anime) marked in the hand fuse the Zombie into a face-up living monster of the opponent's (not a Zombie, a Machine or a Rock), picked with left and right. At the end of each of your turns it loses the Zombie's ATK, down to 0, until it leaves the field. The CPU plays it too.

settings.label: Mai's harpies (anime)
settings.description: As in Mai's duels: Elegant Egotist put onto Harpie Lady, or the two fused from the hand, makes Harpie Lady Sisters, the one harpy split into three. Harpie's Pet Dragon gains 300 ATK for each harpy on its side: Harpie Lady counts one, Harpie Lady Sisters three.

settings.label: Castle of Dark Illusions (anime)
settings.description: As in PaniK's duel with Yugi: with Castle of Dark Illusions face up on the field, its owner's other monsters are in the dark, drawn dark, and cannot be attacked; the castle itself can. Swords of Revealing Light used by the other side lights the field: that castle hides no one any more. Both sides.

settings.label: Mirror Force
settings.description: Mirror Force, a trap of this mod's (password 44095762), springs on any attack of the opponent's: it stops the attack and turns it back on every monster of theirs in attack position, as Yugi did to Pegasus: all are destroyed, and the opponent loses the attacker's ATK minus each weaker one's (2500 on 1400 and 2200: 1100 + 300). Off, it destroys only the attacker, as Widespread Ruin does.

settings.label: Change of Heart
settings.description: Change of Heart, a magic card of this mod's (password 04031928): pick a monster of the opponent's with left and right; it comes to a free zone of yours as it is and may attack. When the next turn starts it goes back to its owner, or is destroyed if they have no free zone. Refused with nothing to take or no free zone. The CPU plays it on the player's strongest monster when it is stronger than all of its own. Off, the card does nothing.

settings.label: Monster Reborn
settings.description: Monster Reborn, a magic card of this mod's (password 83764718): the mod keeps each side's graveyard, the monsters destroyed in the duel. Pick one of either side's with left and right; it comes back to a free zone of yours, face up in attack. Refused with an empty graveyard or no free zone. The CPU revives the strongest when it is stronger than all of its own. Off, the card does nothing.

settings.label: Magical Hats
settings.description: Magical Hats, a trap of this mod's (password 81210420), springs as Fake Trap does when the opponent attacks: the attack stops. When a monster was attacked, up to three hats go up in its owner's free monster zones and it hides among them, face down in defense in one picked at random; the others hold empty hats (Magical Hat, 0/0) that do nothing. Attacking an empty hat destroys it with no damage; the hats go when the monster hidden among them leaves the field. Off, the card is a Fake Trap.
